preconditions.description: The number of nodes n and the number of inspected nodes k must satisfy the given bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 1000000 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each ai must be within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= ui <= n and 1 <= vi <= n and ui != vi for ui, vi in edges)
preconditions.description: There must be exactly n-1 edges, each connecting two distinct nodes within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(min(a[dfs_order[:k]]) for dfs_order in all_possible_dfs_orders)
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum possible grade Jacob can achieve by choosing the optimal root and neighbor order.
